info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Platform Operations Status API
info.description: The Platform Operations Status API provides real-time insights into the operational status of IT management and banking services. This API allows consumers to monitor the health and performance metrics of various platform components, ensuring optimal service delivery. Use cases include incident management, system monitoring, and performance analysis by IT teams and developers. By integrating this API, organizations can proactively address service disruptions and maintain high levels of operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of platform operations, providing insights into system health and operational metrics.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of platform operations in the IT management system. This includes necessary parameters to specify the operation's status to fetch.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status of platform operations.

GetPlatformOperationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body string for the Operations GET status request.

systemId.description: The unique identifier for the system.

environment.description: The environment where the operation is taking place (e.g., production, staging).

changeId.description: The identifier for the specific change related to this operation.

ownerTeam.description: The team responsible for the operation.

plannedAt.description: The planned timestamp for the operation.

serviceTier.description: The service tier associated with the operation.

availabilityTargetPercent.description: The target availability percentage for the service.

maintenanceWindow.description: The scheduled maintenance window for the operation.

recordStatus.description: The current status of the operation record.

version.description: The version number of the operation status.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the operation status.

metadata.description: Additional metadata related to the operation.

GetPlatformOperationsStatusResponse_200.description: Represents the status response for platform operations.

responseId.description: The unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: The correlation identifier for tracking purposes.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp when the metadata was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region where the processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Metadata associated with the operation status.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer token for authentication. If using JWT (JSON Web Tokens), ensure that the token is valid and properly signed.
